ValidationRule.description: Freight - checks the AWB# entered is in a correct format "XXX-XXXXXXXX"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName,'Freight'), NOT(ISBLANK(Freight_AWB_Number__c)), NOT(REGEX( Freight_AWB_Number__c ,"[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{8}" )), Not ((AND ((ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(Origin, "Web")))), FCR__c = FALSE, NOT ( $Profile.Id = '00e90000001yRSS' ) /*Data Administrator*/ )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: AWB # must be in "XXX-XXXXXXXX" number format
